payload.title: An ideation agent files a batch of invented premises on a schedule
payload.description:
Requested by Humorus (HUM-e155f8, milestone HUM-b0d999), Ryan 2026-11-18: TheHallucinator.ai wants a daily cycle where one agent comes up with a set of story ideas and another picks the funniest to develop.

Today every idea starts from a Reference: premise-led mode (PPY-10a5e5) still loops over monitor-delivered References. Add an ideation mode that needs no Reference: the agent reads the site's mission, policy, section doctrine, writing guidelines and its recent and in-flight Stories, and files N premise Ideas per run (Idea stage, marked Generated, each with its invented premise and section). The mode and N are site data (ideaRules), not code; the prompt text is site-owned through the guidelines and agent-instructions layers, with the scaffold writing the default. Registered as a core agent definition with a schedule (wakes.schedule) and adopted per site like rate.yaml; it runs at the site's rung and never above propose.

Scenario: a site set to invented premises with N=10 gets 10 new Ideas at the scheduled time, none citing a Reference. Scenario: a site in evidence mode is unchanged. Scenario: ideas never repeat a premise already in the site's recent or in-flight Stories.
Standing rules: no workarounds, fallbacks or shims; Gherkin specs.
